items.a: Blueberry Lavender contains gluten (oats) and Raspberry Rose contains milk. The other four contain no allergens.
Up to three months at −18 °C. Once they have melted, don’t refreeze them.
Four of the six flavours are vegan. Each flavour says so.
To Altona, Ottensen, Eimsbüttel, Sternschanze, St. Pauli and HafenCity, the same day.

items.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
items.a: Yes, up to two hours before your slot.
